_comment: Same hole, same shape, on the agent side: `agent/tsconfig.json` also excludes test/. Clean today (the final review measured 0 errors here), which is exactly why it needs a gate — a directory that is clean and unchecked becomes a directory that is dirty and unchecked without anything saying so.
